findings.statement: A compact historical-propensity and persistence model is competitive with the full matched flexible predictor on held participants

reliability.rationale: Participant Brier0.156958 is only0.000765 below flexible, with paired resampling interval crossing zero; history-only diagnostic0.16199 shows most benefit arises from personal choice persistence. Claim-specific scope: A compact historical-propensity and persistence model is competitive with the full matched flexible predictor on held participants

mechanism.rationale: Repeated identical lotteries and prior choices create strong conditional predictability without uniquely separating stable preference, attitude and learning.

novelty.rationale: Primary-source analyses and established equation families are disclosed. This review does not establish exhaustive literature novelty or a new universal law.

significance.rationale: Useful as a transparent bounded research/evaluation case. Current feedback type on unannounced first choices was an input-budget defect for future agents. Version1.1 masks it until announced or previously revealed; original evidence is preserved and all9 frozen predictions remain unchanged.108 held participants do not establish real-world decision transfer.

reproducibility.rationale: Exact task, equation/state, group evidence, native semantics and provenance inspected; separate computational review is responsible for complete replay.

impact.rationale: No independent deployment, intervention, cost saving or clinical/industrial acceptance outcome was measured.

reliability.rationale: All saved predictions and primary metrics independently reproduce from source-verified inputs, including unfavorable alternatives. Historical-choice Brier improvement over the flexible model is small and the paired interval crosses zero. Causal feedback masking is explicit; unfitted empirical-propensity and previous-choice diagnostics were added after confirmation and cannot alter selection.

mechanism.rationale: Computational agreement cannot identify a physical or causal mechanism. Historical-choice Brier improvement over the flexible model is small and the paired interval crosses zero. reproducibility.rationale: Native reconstruction, independent group-weighted metric reduction, frozen replay, row-order invariance and target-poisoning checks passed. Development validation identities were checked against recorded training membership.

impact.rationale: No deployed intervention, operational saving, clinical qualification or independently measured safety benefit is established.
